Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner: workers the operator provides (register a Woodpecker agent with WOODPECKER_AGENT_LABELS=ubuntu-latest=true for the runner labels)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.if: pull request test (Woodpecker holds the target branch in CI_COMMIT_BRANCH on a pull request, so the condition gains a pull request test; the source condition is kept in a marker)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
